lifecycle_admin_erasure: Deletion requested on {date}. The listing stays hidden until the owner cancels or it is purged.
lifecycle_trusted: Trusted: edits go live at once
lifecycle_trusted_hint: Turn off to send this listing's edits through the review queue.
lifecycle_suspend_body: The listing, its opportunities and its connections disappear from every public view and the page answers gone. The owner gets your reason by email and sees it in their account.
lifecycle_failed: Nothing changed. The listing is not in a state where this applies.
lifecycle_error: The action failed. Please try again.
lifecycle_owner_none: You do not have a listing yet.
lifecycle_owner_suspended_body: It is hidden from visitors until the reason is resolved. Reason: {reason}
lifecycle_owner_erasure: Deletion is scheduled. Your listing is hidden.
lifecycle_confirm_button: Confirm my listing is up to date
lifecycle_confirm_hint: Visitors see the date as Last updated. Do it every few months.
lifecycle_confirm_done: Thank you. The date is updated.
lifecycle_archive_hint: Archived listings disappear from public pages. You can bring yours back at any time.
lifecycle_unarchive_consent: I agree that my full name, description, town and other details are published in the public registry and can be found by search engines. I am 16 or older.
lifecycle_unarchive_unavailable: Your listing cannot be shown right now. If a deletion is scheduled, cancel it first.
lifecycle_withdraw_hint: Your listing is hidden at once. Copies that search engines already stored can stay until they refresh.
lifecycle_withdraw_done: Consent withdrawn. Your listing is hidden.
lifecycle_export_body: A JSON file with your account, your listing, its translations, opportunities, connections, decisions about it and its change history. It contains only your own data.
lifecycle_export_failed: The download failed. Please try again.
lifecycle_erase_body: Your listing is hidden at once and everything is deleted after {days} days. Until then you can cancel here.
lifecycle_erase_confirm_body: Your listing is archived now. After {days} days we delete the listing, images, translations, contact data and connections, remove personal details from the change log and delete your account. You can cancel until then.
lifecycle_erase_scheduled: Deletion is scheduled for {date}. Your listing is hidden. We sent you an email about it.
lifecycle_erase_scheduled_toast: Deletion scheduled. Your listing is hidden.
lifecycle_erase_cancelled: Deletion cancelled. Your listing is back as it was.
